name: quizlar
description: Voice-led, FSRS-scheduled flashcards from YouTube, PDFs, web, or text. Auto-graded quizzes.
long_description: Quizlar is the learning MCP server. It turns YouTube videos, PDFs, web URLs, or pasted text into flashcards, then runs interactive quizzes with FSRS spaced-repetition scheduling so the material sticks. 22 tools that map one-to-one to learner verbs: ingest, quiz, review, track. Same grading and scheduling pipeline that powers the consumer voice app at quizlar.app.

api_key.title: Quizlar API key
api_key.description: Your Quizlar API key (format: sk-qz-<32 chars>). Mint one at https://quizlar.app/settings/api-keys.
